item.tib: dmar khrid dgongs pa yongs 'dus las rdzogs pa chen po ye shes rang shar
item.coloph: ces pas dmar khrid dgongs pa yongs 'dus rdzogs pa chen po ye shes rang shar zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lung dang mngon par rtog (rtogs) pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa'i nor gyi bang mdzod yongs su gtams pa'i gnas brten yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po/ nang so g.yung drung bstan 'dzin khu dbon gyis kyang ta (da) nas bzung te thugs la gang bab kyi rtsom pa yag po re gyis la zhog dang bstan 'gro la phan thog pa yong gi lung bstan pa dang*/ nye bar rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse gcig tu bsdus pa/ lnga brgya ba rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug gi nor bu/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba nyid dang mtshungs pa/ sprul sku bye ba phrag brgya'i dbu na mngon par 'phags pa/ skye dgu ma lus pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ thams can mkhyen pa gter ston chen po byang chub snying po bde ba'i rdo rje rtsal du grags shing / bstan gnyis nyin mo'i mgon po bzhed pa pad ma g.yung drung gi zhal nas kyang / bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du mdzad pa rlabs po che dgos tshul/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i lung gi bskul ba la gsung 'os bslu ba med pa gnang ba dang / gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po du ma zhig gi (gis) yang yang bskul ba brten nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad pa cung zad thob pa'i gar dbang kun grol grags pa 'bod pa bdag gi (gis) dre shod gnas chen pad ma brtsegs pa'i nye 'dabs/ gdan sa dar rgyas g.yung drung gling gi gzims (gzim) chung mkha' spyod yang rtse ru yongs 'dzin zhes pa sa chu hor zla drug pa'i dkar phyogs su sbyar ba/ yi ge pa ni sdom brtson gtsug phud khi khar gyi (gyis) bgyis pa 'dis kyang / kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas shing phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/
